$comment: Demonic Pacts' pact tree (docs/leagues.md, Demonic Pacts), used by plugins/modes/LeaguePacts.plugin.js. The nodes are the rev 241 cache's: DB table `talent_tree` (216), one row per node in row order (the node's index, its bit in the unlock varps; recording 237/01098's first buy, payload [1, 0], set bit 0 of combat_mastery_perm_0), with `linked_nodes` (the rows it touches) and `effect` [effect id, value]. Each effect id has its varbit in `effects`, and nodes sharing an effect add their values up (talent_prayer_pen_all 25 -> 50 -> 75). Apply Changes' trigger sends the selected nodes as one int array, its length as a plain varint and each node zigzag-encoded (237/01098: [1, 126] set bit 63; 238: [2, 88, 94] bought nodes 44 and 47). Everything sent is by gameval name. Flow and texts from the Leagues VI recordings 237/01098, 01102, 01103, 01149, 01158, 01167, 01170 and 238/01219, 01223; the rules (40 points to spend of the 44 the tasks give, two of them the tutorial's; six resets: two free, one for the Hueycoatl's first kill and three from echo bosses, both reset tasks (`resetTasks`); PvP limits) are the Wiki's Demonic_Pacts_League/Demonic_Pacts.
_effects: Each node's effect id -> the varbit the client reads for it, by what the node's text says (the table carries no varbit, and the ids are not the varbits' order). Checked against the recordings: 1, 12, 13, 14, 18, 19, 20, 23, 25, 26, 40 (237/01158's reset), 43 (237/01098, light_weapon_doublehit), 64, 65, 73, 75, 77 and 84 (237/01158). A node's value adds to its effect's varbit.

start._comment: A new Demonic Pacts character: no point yet (the tutorial's two are its pact tasks, Open the Leagues Menu and Complete the Leagues Tutorial: 237/01098 earns each with the task's own line) and the two free resets the Wiki gives, both flagged (talent_free_reset_1 and _2: live flagged each as it was given, the second with 'Yama has taken kindly...' to characters that already played, 238/01219).

resetTasks._comment: Pact reset tasks: each gives a reset after its pact point, with the resetEarned line (237/01158: Defeat 3 unique Echo Bosses, the point, then talent_resets_available 2 -> 3 and the line). Wiki: the Hueycoatl's first kill became a reset task on 23 April 2026, and three resets come from echo bosses; which three of the four unique-echo-boss tasks is ours (1, 2 and 3; 3 is the recorded one).

interface._comment: talent_tree (647) in the toplevel floater as an overlay (237/01098, 01102): the main modal closed first, league_border_pulse_stop (3186) on league_side_panel:mastery_highlight, the floater, if_setevents frame 647:5 slot 11 OP1, data_layer 647:11 IF_SCRIPT_TRIGGER, perm_floating_panel_content 647:20 OP1 and IF_SCRIPT_TRIGGER, then talent_tree_init (7892) [1] and script 9397. frame slot 11 closes it.
interface._buy: Nodes bought (data_layer's script trigger, Apply Changes: [count, 2 x node, ...]), each: talent_points_spent, the node's unlock bit, its effect varbit; then once: busy, human_relic_unlock with leagues_6_mastery_unlock at height 92, pvp_icons_comlevelrange (5224) with the combat level, the floater closed and sounds 4215/4211/4213/4212 at 8/44/80/104; five ticks later the tree again (237/01098, 01102, 01149).
